rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: Three eligible species (VU, forest-associated, felling-relevant, site-bound lichens) are recorded 771–782 m from the polygon, and none within 250 m. They are Usnea barbata (2022, 25 m uncertainty), Alectoria sarmentosa (2016) and Platismatia norvegica (2016).
No records lie inside the polygon or within 250 m, and near-site effort there is 0 records, equal to the county median of 0. Effort within 1000 m is adequate (114 records vs county median 20.5).

Completed felling overlaps 32.8% of the polygon (0.398 ha, from fellings dated 2004 and 2016), which is below the 50% threshold, so the site is not classed as already felled. Part of the polygon has been cleared before.
Three NT site-bound forest species are recorded at 782–800 m. All are beyond 250 m, so they do not trigger the NT-count rule.

uncertainties: The eligible records are 771–782 m away. They do not show that the species occupy the polygon.
Two of the three eligible records are from 2016.
The earlier fellings overlap part of the polygon, so the remaining stand may differ from the habitat at the records. Stand condition is not described by any tool.
not_established: That the polygon holds or lacks eligible species.
That absence of records within 250 m means absence of species.
Whether the felling is legal or appropriate.
next_action: Have a reviewer check whether the habitat around the 771–782 m lichen records continues into the unfelled part of the polygon. Decide whether a targeted lichen check is warranted before felling begins.
